findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: createImage, generateWithStyle, editImage, rotateSprite, transferMotion, rotateSpritesheet, createVideo, removeBackground, create3DModel, animate3DModelPreset · Private data: validateApiKeyEndpoint, getDocs, searchDocs, createSpriteAudio, rigModel, animate3DModel, animate3DModelPreset, createSoundEffect, createAmbiance, createMusic, createAudioTransform, createVoice, createSpeech, createSpeechPreset, submitApiFeedback · Public sink: createImage, submitApiFeedback · Destructive: createImage, editImage, animateSprite, animateSpriteKeyframes, transferMotion, editSpritesheet, createVideoFromReferences, upscaleVideo, removeBackground, submitApiFeedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: createImage, generateWithStyle, editImage, rotateSprite, transferMotion, rotateSpritesheet, createVideo, removeBackground, create3DModel, animate3DModelPreset · Private data: validateApiKeyEndpoint, getDocs, searchDocs, createSpriteAudio, rigModel, animate3DModel, animate3DModelPreset, createSoundEffect, createAmbiance, createMusic, createAudioTransform, createVoice, createSpeech, createSpeechPreset, submitApiFeedback · Public sink: createImage, submitApiFeedback · Destructive: createImage, editImage, animateSprite, animateSpriteKeyframes, transferMotion, editSpritesheet, createVideoFromReferences, upscaleVideo, removeBackground, submitApiFeedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
